title: sonchus tenerrimus subsp. pustulatus
intro: Sonchus tenerrimus subsp. pustulatus, commonly known as the slender sow thistle, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and asthma. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of Sonchus tenerrimus subsp. pustulatus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
